title: Turkish Revani Prawns Stuffed with Flavorful Spices
description: A twist on traditional Turkish dessert, Revani. This recipe combines succulent prawns with the warm flavors of roasted spices and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together flavorful spices, cumin, and paprika.
3. Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
4. Stuff each prawn with the spice mixture, dividing it evenly.
5. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
6. Add stuffed prawns to the skillet and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
7. Transfer prawns to a baking dish and bake for 8-10 minutes.
8. Meanwhile, crumble revani into small pieces.
9. Remove prawns from the oven and top each with crumbled revani.
